items.title: Vampire Watering Moonflowers
items.alt: A vampire in rolled sleeves waters a single wide planter with two broad moonflowers using a small watering can.
items.description: A vampire in rolled sleeves waters a single wide planter with two broad moonflowers using a small watering can. Useful for nature story prompts.

items.title: Vampire with a Berry Drink
items.alt: A friendly vampire in a red-lined cape raises a clear tumbler of purple berry juice, small grape bunch on a tray in the other hand.
items.description: A friendly vampire in a red-lined cape raises a clear tumbler of purple berry juice, small grape bunch on a tray in the other hand. Useful for party food labels.

items.title: Vampire Flying a Crescent Kite
items.alt: A vampire girl in a short teal cape holds the reel of a crescent-shaped kite with one broad ribbon tail.
items.description: A vampire girl in a short teal cape holds the reel of a crescent-shaped kite with one broad ribbon tail. Useful for outdoor imagination cards.
